operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to launch into the enterprise market.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the launch planning going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It has shifted a bit. Earlier, I planned to launch into the enterprise market, but I now plan to launch into the SMB market.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What prompted the change in direction?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The change came from the customer feedback. It pointed more clearly toward an SMB launch.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a useful signal. Have you updated the rollout details?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the launch plan is in the go-to-market doc now.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier enterprise launch plan and retain the current SMB plan and its rationale.
